text:
elaine_sales: FYI — Acme Health needs final SIG/CAIQ + DPA redlines by EOD Friday. POC sign-off blocked on data deletion + retention clarifications. Can we pull answers together?

sam_se: Quick Q — do they want per-user deletion (DSAR) or full-project wipe for the POC? that'll change the impl.

customer_jordan: We need both. Our privacy team may request DSAR exports and a deletion confirmation for test patient records. Timeline: they want evidence before kick-off next week.

maria_privacy: We can support DSAR exports + deletions. Process: customer files DSAR to privacy@redwood.com, we verify identity, then provide export within 30 days. For deletions we remove data from active stores within 48 hours; backups policy below. Link to privacy FAQ: https://redwood.company/privacy/faq :wave:

aj_security: Encryption & controls: all customer data encrypted at rest with customer-managed KMS for Private and Dedicated; hosted uses our KMS but keys can be CMK in partner clouds. No customer data is used to train models. SOC2 + pentest artifacts available for vendor review (I can share).

elaine_sales: Important for their vendor risk: they asked for SOC2 report, pen test summary, and a completed CAIQ. Can we commit to providing those this week?

aj_security: SOC2 + pentest summary: yes, we can provide redacted copies. CAIQ: SE can populate the standard responses, I'll review. Expect deliverables by Thu.

sam_se: About retention: default request/log retention is 30 days. We can enable configurable retention per-customer for POC (7/30/90 days). Debug traces (full prompt+response) are off by default unless customer toggles. Also note: KV cache may hold prefixes until TTL/flush — we can set per-tenant cache TTL to minimize exposure.

maria_privacy: Backup retention note: hosted backups are retained up to 90 days; for Dedicated/Private we can align to contract. Deletion from backups is via overwrite/retention expiry, we can add contractual language in DPA re: backup deletion window.

legal_ops: DPA + SCCs: we have a DPA template that includes EU SCCs (v4) — legal can accept customer redlines for standard clauses; for high-risk redlines we may need exec signoff. I'll upload the template.

deploy-bot: new file uploaded: https://drive.redwood.com/sales/acme/2026-03-18/DPA-template-v3.docx

customer_jordan: Also: their InfoSec asked whether redwood stores PII in logs and for precise retention numbers. Can you list where PII might appear and controls to remove it?

aj_security: PII can appear in request payloads; by default we store request metadata + tokens for 30d. We offer request-scrubbing helpers (SDK middleware) to remove PII before sending. For evidence: we can provide a short runbook showing how we scrub and a sample log export with PII redacted.

sam_se: Action items: 1) I will populate CAIQ answers + flag any technical gaps (owner: sam_se) 2) aj_security to attach SOC2/pentest redacted artifacts (owner: aj_security) 3) maria_privacy to draft DSAR/deletion language for DPA (owner: maria_privacy) 4) legal_ops to upload DPA + SCCs; track redlines (owner: legal_ops). Due: Thu EOD. I've placed a checklist in the shared doc: https://drive.redwood.com/sales/acme/2026-03-18/presales-checklist.md :thumbsup:

elaine_sales: Perfect — I'll push timeline to customer and ask for any last security questionnaire items by tomorrow. If we hit blockers, we can offer Dedicated evaluation or Private trial for data residency.

maria_privacy: One more: for deletions we provide a confirmation artifact (deletion ticket ID + timestamp) back to customer. Include that in the DPA appendix.

customer_jordan: Thanks team — that should cover their privacy gating questions. I’ll confirm timeline with their legal/security and send any redlines asap.

aj_security: Quick note — if they need shorter backup deletion windows for POC, recommend Dedicated/Private. For hosted we can propose a contractual SLA for data handling during POC.

elaine_sales: OK noted. meeting in 30 to review CAIQ draft. :calendar:
